name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was returned.

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart documentation from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Verified FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox environment
3. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present in the sandbox)
4. Wrote the quickstart script following the documented Python (OpenAI SDK) example
5. The model specified in the docs (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 "Model not found" error
6. Queried the available models endpoint and selected `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` (a chat-capable model)
7. Ran the script successfully — it printed "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but this model returned a 404 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' error. I had to substitute `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2`, which was confirmed available via the /models API and supports chat completions. This is the only deviation from the documented instructions.
